over 64 MiB, judged by its length.reason: the model is more than 67108864 bytes

shorter than the envelope's header.reason: the model ends before its envelope's header

a bad magic.reason: the body is not a pvm1 model (no PVM1 magic)

another envelope version.reason: the model's envelope version 2 is not 1

params past the body.reason: the model's params run past the body

truncated params.reason: the model's params run past the body

params that are not JSON.reason: the model's params are not JSON

params that are a JSON array.reason: the model's params are not JSON

a model length not the remainder.reason: the model length 9111 is not what follows its params (9112 bytes)

another vec1 version.reason: the model was trained by vec1 0.7, this device runs 0.8

dims not the field's.reason: the model is for dims 9, the field holds 8

a distance not the index's.reason: the model measures distance l2, the index measures cos

nbucket 0.reason: the model's nbucket 0 is outside 1 to 65536

nbucket 65,537.reason: the model's nbucket 65537 is outside 1 to 65536

an unknown quantizer.reason: the model's quantizer sq is not none, pq, opq or bq

a none model with a codesize.reason: the model's codesize 4 is outside 0 (no quantizer)

a pq codesize past the dims.reason: the model's codesize 9 is outside 1 to 8

an opq codesize of 0.reason: the model's codesize 0 is outside 1 to 8

a bq codesize vec1 never trains.reason: the model's codesize 3 is not 1 or 1, the codesizes vec1 trains bq with over dims 8

a registration nbucket the params do not.reason: the registration's nbucket is 316, the model's 20

a registration codesize the params do no.reason: the registration's codesize is 2, the model's 4

a registration quantizer the params do n.reason: the registration's quantizer is pq, the model's opq

rows 0.reason: the model's rows 0 is not a positive integer

rows not an integer.reason: the model's rows 1.5 is not a positive integer

a trainedAt that is not a date.reason: the model's trainedAt is not a date-time

a vec1 header of another version.reason: the vec1 header version 9 is not 4

a vec1 header with another nElem.reason: the vec1 header says nElem 16, the params say dims 8

a vec1 header with another nBucket.reason: the vec1 header says nBucket 21, the params say nbucket 20

a vec1 header with another nCodebook.reason: the vec1 header says nCodebook 3, codesize 4 over dims 8 makes 4

a vec1 header with another eDistance.reason: the vec1 header says eDistance 1, the params say cos

a vec1 header with no rotation for opq.reason: the vec1 header flags 5 do not match quantizer opq

a vec1 header with the bit quantizer fla.reason: the vec1 header flags 15 do not match quantizer opq

a vec1 header with a flag vec1 does not.reason: the vec1 header flags 69 do not match quantizer pq

a bq header with BITQUANT clear.reason: the vec1 header flags 21 do not match quantizer bq

a bq header with ROTATE set.reason: the vec1 header flags 31 do not match quantizer bq

a layout one coefficient short.reason: the vec1 model is 9108 bytes, its header's layout 9112

a vec1 model shorter than its header.reason: the vec1 model is 20 bytes, less than its header

a NaN in a codebook.reason: the vec1 model has a coefficient that is not finite (byte 28)

an Infinity in a centroid.reason: the vec1 model has a coefficient that is not finite (byte 8224)

a NaN in a bq centroid.reason: the vec1 model has a coefficient that is not finite (byte 36)
